Title: General availability: HNSW vector index in vCore-based Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB

Body.Content:
The HNSW vector index is now generally available in vCore-based Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB in M40 and above cluster tiers! This enables your applications to scale to millions of vector embeddings at high accuracy and fast speeds. 

Learn more.
